# Doha Roastery | دوحة روستري

> Doha Roastery is a specialty coffee roastery based in Doha, Qatar. It serves individuals and supplies cafes, hotels, and restaurants across Qatar.

## Official information

- Website: https://www.doharoastery.com
- Products: https://www.doharoastery.com/products

- Honey: https://www.doharoastery.com/honey
- Wholesale program: https://www.doharoastery.com/wholesale
- About: https://www.doharoastery.com/about
- Contact: https://www.doharoastery.com/contact

## Contact and service area
